==Description==
'''Legacy Gilded Path''' is intended to be a community [[Maps|map]] which uses the first version of [[Gilded Path]]. However, due to developer oversight, it is instead completely unplayable. It takes place near an old stone temple, filled with ruins.

==Design & Path==
'''Legacy Gilded Path''' takes place on a mountain with an old stone temple located on it, which is overgrown with vegetation. A large staircase can be found on the back of it, with a rusted humanoid sitting on it, which looks similar to the [[Rusted]] enemy. There is a forest next to the mountain near the exit. Multiple other ruins can also be seen there. Dead [[Golden]]s can be seen across the map, alongside the [[Gold Titan]], with its sword next to it. A few trees can also be seen on the mountain.

The rusted path starts at the temple and ends at a cave. The path splits near the stone ruin with two dead [[Golden]]s laying on it, one going left and the other right. The right path will go through a bridge. After some time, the path becomes brown. The two paths shortly meet at an intersection, enemies which are on either side of the path will be switched to the other, and then merge into each other near the end of the map.

==Rewards==
The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map.

Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal.

{{Rewards|Hard|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}}

==Strategy==
*It is recommended to place your towers near the intersection.
**These spots are especially useful for towers like the [[Pyromancer]], [[Shotgunner]] and [[Assassin]], as their pierce allows them to kill enemies from both paths.
**Do note that you cannot place ground towers on certain parts of the map, which limits your placement. It is recommended to put your towers near the second intersection as it offers more space.
*There are multiple cliff spots on this map. However, they are spread out across the entire map, making them harder to use.

==Trivia==
*Multiple dead [[Golden]]s can be seen laying on the ground, alongside the [[Gold Titan]], which are enemies that appeared in the removed [[Golden Mode|Golden]] mode.
**The word "''Gilded''" in the map name is most likely referring to these enemies being scattered across the map.
**The [[24 Karat]] and [[Gold Guard]] are not present on the map, despite also being golden enemies.
**A rusted humanoid can also be seen on the back of the temple that looks similar to the [[Rusted]], a Pre-MEGA enemy.
**Due to the map creator not having access to the original [[Gold Titan]] model, the model used has a 4-pack which was not present on the enemy.
*Despite the map being available to play in the [[Elevators|Elevator]] rotation, the map cannot be seen in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode or through [[Matchmaking]].
